source_note: Political/policy dates for the Bean Brief homepage calendar. Elections + Iowa filing deadlines from the Iowa Secretary of State; farm bill + appropriations deadlines from Congress.gov/CRS (as of 2026-07-30). Comment deadlines are NOT here — they are captured dynamically per-rule from the Federal Register / Regulations.gov feeds.
review_note: REVIEW & EXTEND: the regulatory category is seeded light — Matt tracks EPA RFS/RVO annual-rule windows, 45Z clean-fuel-credit guidance, WOTUS timelines, and trade/tariff deadlines more closely than public calendars capture. Add them here as concrete dates land; keep impact honest (very_high/high/medium/low).

events.title: Iowa candidate filing deadline (state & federal offices)
events.note: Last day for state and federal candidates to file nomination papers for the June 2 primary (filing opened Feb 23).

events.title: Iowa candidate filing deadline (county offices)
events.note: Last day for county candidates to file for the June 2 primary.

events.title: Iowa Primary Election
events.note: Closed primary — sets the November ballot, incl. Governor, Secretary of Agriculture, all 4 U.S. House seats, and the Iowa Legislature.

events.title: General Election
events.note: Midterm general election — Governor, Secretary of Agriculture, all 4 Iowa U.S. House seats, Iowa House + half the Iowa Senate. Reshapes the delegation the Bean Brief tracks.

events.title: House Ag approved Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026 (H.R. 7567)
events.note: House Agriculture Committee approved H.R. 7567 (34–17). A milestone toward farm bill reauthorization.

events.title: Senate Ag discussion draft — Agricultural Act of 2026
events.note: Senate Agriculture Committee (Chair Boozman) released its discussion draft for a new five-year farm bill.

events.title: Farm bill extension EXPIRES
events.note: The current farm bill extension lapses. Without reauthorization or another extension, programs face the 'permanent law' cliff. The central ag-policy deadline of 2026.

events.title: Federal fiscal year 2027 begins
events.note: Start of FY2027; funding runs under the FY2027 continuing resolution until the Dec 4 deadline.

events.title: Federal funding deadline (FY2027 continuing resolution expires)
events.note: The FY2027 CR expires; Congress must pass appropriations or another CR to avoid a shutdown. USDA/FSA/RMA operations at stake.

events.title: Iowa Legislature convenes (2027 session)
events.note: Second regular session of the 92nd General Assembly convenes (second Monday of January). Watch for water-quality, ag-land, biofuel, and eminent-domain (CO2 pipeline) bills.
